coordinates: Metres east and north of the extent's south-west corner, to a decimetre — the same frame as the map geometry.
note: Every layer here is calculated from a filtered photogrammetric surface, not recorded. Surface-water paths follow the steepest descent of that surface and are not a survey of where water has been seen to go; low points are hollows measured on it; the unavailable areas are where too little ground was observed to say anything. The interface must label all three System-derived.

settings.display_only: The depression size threshold is a display filter. The scenario engine uses every hollow the pipeline found, whatever is drawn here.

covers: These layers are calculated from a measured ground surface that exists for kensington only -- 1,000 by 1,000 metres of the 8,500 by 9,000 this extent covers, with its south-west corner at (1,500, 6,000). Everywhere else on this map, the ground has not been measured and nothing is claimed about where water goes.
